description: This file defines a Java class for an Android activity called Vertices, which demonstrates graphics rendering using custom View and Canvas. It contains methods for drawing vertices and mesh manipulations in an Android graphics application.

classes.name: Vertices
classes.description: An Android activity class that demonstrates drawing with vertices, mesh transformations, and touch interactions.

classes.name: SampleView
classes.description: A custom View subclass used within Vertices activity to perform drawing and handle touch events.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the content view to a custom View.

methods.name: setXY
methods.description: Helper method to set x and y coordinates into a float array at a specified index.

methods.name: SampleView
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the view, loads a bitmap resource, sets up shaders, and prepares mesh data.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Handles the drawing of the vertices on the canvas, including applying transformations.

methods.name: onTouchEvent
methods.description: Handles touch input to modify vertex positions in real-time, enabling interactive graphics.
